correctness.rationale: PASS: Antipodal-even/odd Laplacian decomposition supplies g_j=(q^j-q^(n-j))/(2sqrt3(1+q^n)), q=2-sqrt3, and the rim current by a unit source. Summing paired opposite absolute currents uses |a+b|+|a-b|=2max(|a|,|b|), leaving S_n=sum_{j=1}^floor((n-1)/2)(g_j-1/(2n))_+. This gives the two exact rim-column formulas; chord formulas are 6g0+4sum g_j for Q and 1+2g0+4sum g_j for C. Positivity and explicitly treated small n prove strict rim dominance for n>=4. The moving threshold L_n=log n/log(2+sqrt3)+O(1) gives common 2 log n/(n log(2+sqrt3)) deficit. Independent exact-rational grounded-Laplacian inversion for every edge column M_{2n}, n=4..11, reproduced both orbit norms (C3_OK). The n=3 K3,3 boundary is explicitly excluded from strict orbit claim.
